nameOrigin: to heat/fry (referring to cooking and its Fire type)

pokedexEntries.bk: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

pokedexEntries.wh: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
